evidenceFollowUp.description:
Send a second, short message right after a firing notification with
what Kamerton found about the probable cause: the dependency chain,
what changed in the workload in the last 30 minutes (new version,
restarts, pods not ready, warning events), the operation with most
errors, an error log line and a link to failing traces. It goes to the
same Telegram chats and email recipients as the alert, only through the
bot and mail server configured in Kamerton, and only in a cluster.
Nothing is sent when nothing useful was found. Default: true.

groupByCause.description:
One message per incident: while a service that others depend on
(dependsOn) has an error, latency, "requests stopped" or "no ready
pods" alert, the error, latency, "requests stopped" and SLO burn-rate
alerts of the services that call it are muted in Alertmanager, so the
cause arrives instead of a pile of follow-on alerts. Memory, CPU,
restart, queue and "no data" alerts are never muted. Services in a
dependency cycle do not mute each other. Default: true; set to false to
get every alert separately. The system "no data" alert mutes the
per-service ones either way.

groupBy.description: Labels used to group alerts into one notification. Default: alertname, service.

repeatInterval.description: How often to repeat a notification for an alert that is still firing. Default: 4h.

routes.description:
Routes limited to some services: the receiver gets only alerts of the
listed services with the listed severities. Use critical/warning above

items.description: Route sends alerts of some services to one receiver.

services.description: Service names whose alerts are delivered.

severities.description: Severities to deliver. Empty means all severities.

timeZone.description:
Time zone of the times in notification messages, as an IANA name such as
Asia/Almaty or Europe/Berlin. Times are shown with their offset, for
example "09:18 16.11 UTC+5". Default: UTC.

critical.description: Critical services page on-call; others create warnings.

customRules.description:

items.description: CustomRule is an alert written by the user. Exactly one of condition or expr must be set.

condition.description: Condition assembled from parts: metric, function, aggregation, comparison.

aggregation.description: How to combine series: max, min, avg, sum or count. Default: max.

by.description: Labels kept after aggregation: one alert per combination of their values.

function.description:

operator.description: Comparison with the threshold: gt (>), gte (>=), lt (<), lte (<=), eq (==), ne (!=).

stack.description:

Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry Collector) the system uses, as

ID falls back to the built-in set with a warning.

telemetry.description:
Names of metrics and labels in your Prometheus. Defaults follow the
OpenTelemetry span metrics connector and cAdvisor; override them if your
pipeline names things differently.

containerLabel.description: Label holding the container name (kube-state-metrics). Default: container.

cpuMetric.description: CPU usage counter in seconds. Default: container_cpu_usage_seconds_total.

limitsMetric.description:
Container resource limits (from kube-state-metrics, with a "resource"
label of memory or cpu). Default: kube_pod_container_resource_limits.
Set to "-" to disable the alerts on usage close to the limit.

memoryMetric.description: Memory gauge in bytes. Default: container_memory_working_set_bytes.

namespaceLabel.description: Label holding the Kubernetes namespace. Default: namespace.

podLabel.description: Label holding the pod name. Default: pod.

readyMetric.description:
Pod readiness (from kube-state-metrics, with a "condition" label of
true, false or unknown). Default: kube_pod_status_ready. Set to "-" to
disable the "no ready pods" alert.

restartsMetric.description: Container restarts counter (from kube-state-metrics). Default: kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total. Set to "-" to disable restart alerts.

terminatedReasonMetric.description:
Reason of the last container termination (from kube-state-metrics, with
a "reason" label). Default: kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason.
Set to "-" to disable the out-of-memory kill alert.

groupLabel.description: Label holding the consumer group. Default: group.

membersMetric.description:
Number of members of a consumer group (with the group label only).
Default: kafka_consumer_group_members. Set to "-" to stop treating a
group without members as a stopped consumer.

offsetMetric.description:
Committed offset of a consumer group (per group, topic and partition).
Default: kafka_consumer_group_offset_ratio. Set to "-" to stop treating
an offset that does not move while messages wait as a stopped consumer.

topicLabel.description: Label holding the topic. Default: topic.

spans.description: Span metrics (RED metrics derived from traces).

durationBucketMetric.description: Histogram bucket series of call durations. Default: traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket.

durationUnit.description: Unit of the duration histogram buckets. Default: ms.

errorStatusValue.description: Value of the status code label that marks an error. Default: STATUS_CODE_ERROR.

operationLabel.description: Label holding the operation (span) name. Default: span_name.

serverSpanKinds.description: Span kinds that represent incoming work of a service. Default: SPAN_KIND_SERVER, SPAN_KIND_CONSUMER.

serviceLabel.description: Label holding the service name. Default: service_name.

spanKindLabel.description: Label holding the span kind. Default: span_kind.

statusCodeLabel.description: Label holding the span status code. Default: status_code.
